verdict:
**QA Review — issues found (not CLEAN):**

**(1) Overlapping / clipped UI — 3 issues:**
- **Top-left app title is clipped**: reads "ckyward Designer 3D" — the "Ba" of "Backyard" is cut off at the screen edge. Fix: add left padding to the toolbar.
- **Bottom-left sidebar**: the "Patio" item is cut off mid-row by the status bar. Fix: make the palette scrollable or shorten the list.
- **Bottom-left flyout menu** (Terrain / Sun & Shadow) crowds the sun-timeline slider and appears to clip its left end; the adjacent "Sun" button also renders with a misaligned duplicate border/ghost box, looking broken.

**(2) 5-second comprehension — mostly yes.** Title, "ADD TO YOUR YARD" palette, 3D lawn, and Basic/Advanced + 3D View/Bird's-eye tabs communicate the app's purpose quickly. Minor: the floating "Daytime" pill mid-sky has no clear anchor, and the Layers panel open by default covers part of the scene.

**(3) Confusing / misplaced:**
- **"Innovate" button** (bottom toolbar, water-drop icon) reads like a typo for "Irrigate" — confusing label.
- **"Terrain" appears twice** — once as an open flyout menu and once as a toolbar button at nearly the same spot; looks duplicated.
- Status bar "FPS: —" is acceptable for an empty scene but may read as broken to new users.

**Summary:** Functional and understandable, but the clipped title, clipped Patio row, crowded/sliver-clipped slider at bottom-left, ghost-bordered "Sun" button, and the "Innovate" label need fixing before ship.
